implemented: Snowflake connection config with account identifier, warehouse, optional role, database, schema, username, password authentication, and query timeout.
Pinned Snowflake SQLAlchemy driver dependency with compatible cryptography and requests versions.
Snowflake adapter URL construction using the Snowflake SQLAlchemy dialect instead of generic host/port modeling.
Snowflake engine login/network timeout options and experimental schema inspection, connection test, explain, and session timeout hooks.
Runtime adapter selection, legacy URL adapter-key detection, and server-side metadata round trip for warehouse, role, schema, authenticator, and query timeout.
Adapter catalog registration as experimental so normal users do not see Snowflake in the default Add Connection flow.
Focused tests for config coercion, URL construction, redaction, options, dialect detection, and experimental catalog exposure.

blocked_or_deferred.reason: No Snowflake account, warehouse, role, or credentials are available in CI/local evidence for this phase.
Snowflake read-only enforcement requires a restricted role and live write-bypass tests; the adapter remains experimental.
Session statement timeout is wired, but warehouse budget policy, cancellation, and result-spill controls need live Snowflake validation.
Promotion requires Snowflake-specific eval cases for fully qualified objects, dates, semi-structured data, limits, identifiers, and warehouse behavior.
Snowflake is intentionally hidden from the normal Add Connection flow while experimental.

release_recommendation: Keep Snowflake experimental; expose only through server-side experimental catalog opt-in until live integration, cost-control, read-only, and dialect eval gates pass.
